chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) said: It was narrated to us by Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Salih ibn al-Sindi from Ibn Sinan from a man from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Ending the fast with water washes the sins of the heart.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of breaking the fast with water according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A'mal*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) links the physical act of breaking the fast with water to spiritual purification, specifically cleansing the 'sins of the heart' (thunub al-qalb). This reflects the Shia emphasis on *khulus* (sincerity) and the idea that simple, sunnah-compliant acts, when performed with mindfulness, serve as a means of wiping away minor spiritual blemishes accumulated during the day.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. My father (rah) said: it was narrated to us by Muhammad b. Yahya from Muhammad b. Ahmad from Ahmad b. Muhammad from Salih b. al-Sindi from Ibn Sinan from a man from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
Ending the fast with water washes the sins of the heart.”
